SignatureProjectShowcase.body1: A full villa fit-out on Palm Jumeirah — joinery, lighting, and finishes coordinated end to end so every room reads as one continuous design language, not a series of separate decisions.

WhyUs.body: We collaborate with trusted artisans and premium suppliers to ensure every structure and interior element reflects superior quality and enduring value.

Risks.title: Renovation projects go wrong in predictable ways.
Risks.subtitle: Here's what we watch for on every project, before it becomes a problem — and exactly how we prevent it.

scope.title: Unclear project scope
scope.prevention: A signed scope document before any contract is issued.

measurements.title: Wrong site measurements
measurements.prevention: Laser-verified site survey ahead of every design drawing.

mep.title: MEP conflicts mid-execution
mep.prevention: MEP drawings cross-checked with design before work starts.

approvals.title: Approval delays
approvals.prevention: Authority submissions handled in-house, tracked end to end.

materials.title: Poor material selection
materials.prevention: Samples approved on-site before any order is placed.

supervision.title: Weak site supervision
supervision.prevention: A dedicated supervisor on-site through every phase.

AboutStory.titlePlain1: Built to close the gap between
AboutStory.body1: G.A.G Interiors started from a simple frustration shared by homeowners across the UAE: design studios draw beautiful renders, contractors execute someone else's drawings, and nobody owns the outcome when things fall between the cracks.
AboutStory.body2: We built a single studio that carries a project from first concept sketch through authority approvals, on-site renovation and custom joinery, to final handover — with one team accountable at every stage.
AboutStory.body3: Today that means over 150 homes and commercial spaces across Dubai, Abu Dhabi and the Northern Emirates, each delivered by the same coordinated process.

FounderSpotlight.title: A studio led by one point of accountability.
FounderSpotlight.body1: G.A.G Interiors was founded on the belief that great interiors come from continuity — the same eye that sketches the first concept should be the one signing off on the last detail of installation. Our founder leads every project personally through design, approvals and execution, working alongside a small team of architects, engineers and craftsmen who share that same standard.
FounderSpotlight.body2: With over a decade shaping residential and commercial interiors across the UAE, the focus has always stayed the same: fewer handoffs, clearer communication, and spaces that feel resolved — not just decorated.
